decisions.statement: G2D-09=A に従う別計画 EXT-ATG（planning.md §1.1 の追加、ATG 0.2.3）が完了し、kit の検査が exit 0、敵対的レビュー none

verification.command: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command "$f = 'work/20260924-0620-EXT-ATG-Confirmation.md'; if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { exit 1 }; if (-not (Select-String -Path $f -Pattern '^evidence: .+ exit=0$' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; if (-not (Select-String -Path tools/atg/skill/references/planning.md -Pattern '^### 1\.1 ' -Quiet)) { exit 1 }; if ((Get-FileHash .github/skills/atg/references/planning.md).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash tools/atg/skill/references/planning.md).Hash) { exit 1 }; if ((Get-FileHash .github/skills/atg/SKILL.md).Hash -ne (Get-FileHash tools/atg/skill/SKILL.md).Hash) { exit 1 }; if ((Get-Content tools/atg/KIT-VERSION.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version -ne '0.2.3') { exit 1 }; python tools/atg/install.py --verify; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }"
